f243f479f1f42257.description: The Manager – Partnerships at Qiddiya Investment Company will play a critical role in driving the growth and development of Qiddiya DMO’s commercial partnership ecosystem. This role is responsible for identifying, securing, and managing strategic partnerships with travel trade organizations, tourism entities, corporate partners, airlines, hospitality brands, and destination co-marketing partners to enhance Qiddiya’s visibility, commercial performance, and market reach. The role involves leading partnership strategy and activation initiatives, managing key partner relationships, and delivering joint commercial programs that support bookings, brand equity, and destination growth. The Manager – Partnerships will work closely with internal stakeholders across Marketing, Events, Commercial, and Operations functions while managing and mentoring the Partnerships team. Key Responsibilities Lead the development and execution of Qiddiya’s partnership strategy across travel trade, tourism boards, airlines, hospitality, corporate, and institutional partners to support overall destination objectives. Develop and manage structured partnership programs, including tiered partnership models, commercial frameworks, and co-marketing initiatives that enhance partner engagement and commercial value. Identify, evaluate, and secure new partnership opportunities across domestic and international markets through proactive business development and strategic relationship management. Lead end-to-end partnership negotiations including proposal development, commercial structuring, contract execution, and activation planning. Build and maintain a robust partnership pipeline utilizing CRM systems to track opportunities, deal stages, partner performance, and revenue contribution. Manage strategic relationships with Tier 1 and Tier 2 partners, ensuring alignment on commercial objectives, marketing activations, booking targets, and long-term collaboration opportunities. Collaborate closely with Marketing and Events teams to execute joint campaigns, destination showcases, co-branded initiatives, and trade activations that drive awareness and bookings. Oversee the development and execution of Familiarization (FAM) programs, partner training initiatives, and trade education platforms to strengthen partner advocacy and destination knowledge. Represent Qiddiya at international travel trade exhibitions, tourism events, and industry forums to strengthen market presence and expand partnership networks. Monitor and analyze partnership performance metrics, commercial ROI, and pipeline progress, providing regular reports, insights, and recommendations to senior leadership. Drive continuous improvement initiatives across partnership management processes, governance frameworks, and commercial activation models. Manage, mentor, and develop team members within the Partnerships function to ensure high performance and professional growth. Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Tourism, Hospitality, or a related field; MBA or postgraduate qualification preferred. At least 6+ years of relevant experience in commercial partnerships, travel trade sales, business development, or destination marketing within tourism, hospitality, or entertainment sectors. Proven experience in sourcing, negotiating, and managing strategic partnerships with travel agencies, tour operators, DMCs, airlines, hospitality partners, or tourism organizations. Strong commercial acumen with demonstrated ability to structure partnership business cases, negotiate commercial agreements, and track performance against revenue and marketing objectives. Experience managing partner engagement programs, trade activations, FAM programs, and co-marketing initiatives. Strong stakeholder management, relationship-building, negotiation, and communication skills with the ability to influence at all organizational levels. Demonstrated leadership capability with experience managing teams and cross-functional collaboration initiatives. Proficiency in CRM systems and partnership pipeline Offering a comprehensive compensation and benefits package.

f23963c15c168733.description: JASARA PMC, a joint venture between Public Investment Fund (PIF), Jacobs, and Saudi Aramco, is seeking a highly motivated Planning Manager to join our team. As the Planning Manager, you will be responsible for leading the planning efforts for large-scale social infrastructure projects in Saudi Arabia. This is an exciting opportunity to work on complex programs that will bring visible change within the Kingdom and contribute to the realization of Vision 2030. At JASARA, we are committed to providing a solutions-based approach to program management and delivering excellence in everything we do. Responsibilities Manages, coaches and mentors’ junior staff to successfully contribute to the department deliverables Consciously seeking ways to improve the provision and quality of services provided to the Project teams. Encourages communication & collaboration with other Teams Continually improve the quality of schedule presentation, information, and documentation. Ensures the preservation of all backup documentation throughout the process, working closely with information management teams. Provides Guidance & support to the team in all aspects of Planning, Cost, Resourcing & Risk. Produces the Project schedule and maintains as per Consultant/Contractor schedule. Ensures the schedule adheres to the Schedule Management Plan, Planning processes and WOW. Resource planning – to indicate the levels of resources. Develops and implements appropriate improvements, ensure optimal project schedule quality, and evaluate reports. Analysis of schedule to identity performance trends, raise for management attention, with mitigation solutions. Review of prepared schedule data for proposals or contract negotiations. Integrates inter-discipline schedule requirements and constraints to establish logical work sequences for assigned disciplines or specialties. Works with the performing organizations and units to coordinate work sequences with the total project plan. Identifies potential and occurring problems affecting the work schedule at the site and recommend solutions to the relevant team/department Continually improve the quality of schedule presentation, information, and documentation. Identifies risks and develops mitigation plans. Clarifying the needs of team to ensure the delivery of effective services. Review, and edit Project progress track and reporting To produce Baseline/Target schedules for submission. Planning and scheduling own work to meet required timelines and outputs. Ensures weekly/monthly updating of schedules as design and construction work develops. Manages sharing of knowledge and information within own team and with internal stakeholders Responds accurately and in a timely manner to team queries regarding the content of the schedule submission. Undertakes strategic planning exercises with wider team Provide inputs in setting up processes and procedures to implement it Identifies key interfaces and manages them efficiently to ensure seamless coordination. Manages coordination with commercial function to implement an effective controls system covering budget, cost, reporting, risk, and change management. 10 years’ experience in construction, preferably within the Infrastructure sector and have experience of playing a key role in multidisciplinary teams and take a managing role in creating plans or analysing trends using numerical and statistical techniques. Support the management of a team of professionals delivering planning/schedule management services and is responsible for staff development. Managing the application of specific planning/scheduling methods, techniques and tools. Giving advice on complex requirements and communicate analysis and corrective measures effectively. Managing the planning/scheduling delivery of medium/high projects/programmes. Providing effective and timely advice to clients. Understanding of data management. Providing attention to detail and ability to validate and check schedule management inputs, recording and reports produced, providing commentary and analysis.

f29e9b0a41897d77.description: Job Title : Senior Consultant Department : Project Delivery Reports To : Engagement Manager Job Summary: The Senior Consultant supports the delivery of consulting engagements by executing defined workstreams, conducting analysis, and contributing to high-quality client deliverables. Reporting to the Engagement Manager , this role plays a critical part in translating project objectives into actionable outputs while maintaining strong collaboration with internal teams and clients. This role requires a driven, detail-oriented professional with strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills, capable of working in structured consulting environments and contributing to client value through rigorous execution and insight generation. Key Responsibilities: Support the delivery of consulting projects across assigned workstreams, ensuring alignment with project scope, timelines, and quality standards. Contribute to day-to-day client interactions, including meetings, workshops, and progress updates, maintaining clear and professional communication. Conduct research, data collection, and analysis to support the development of strategies, organizational assessments, and target operating models. Develop high-quality project deliverables, including presentations, reports, models, and documentation, in line with consulting best practices. Support public sector engagements, including strategy development, organizational development initiatives, and transformation programs. Assist in projects related to strategy execution, value realization, and performance management, including the definition, documentation, and tracking of KPIs. Collaborate closely with cross-functional team members to ensure consistency, accuracy, and integration of outputs across workstreams. Support proposal development and business development activities through research, content development, and analysis. Communicate findings, insights, and recommendations clearly to the Engagement Manager and broader project team. Provide guidance and informal support to junior consultants or analysts, contributing to a collaborative team environment. General Role Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Business, Management, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. Relevant professional certifications are an advantage. 4–7 years of experience, preferably within a consulting or professional services environment. Experience supporting management consulting engagements in the public sector in Saudi Arabia is strongly preferred. Experience in relevant consulting practices and frameworks including strategy development, organizational design, change management, digital transformation, development of business and operating models, business case development, initiatives roadmap, value realization, and enterprise performance management. Strong analytical, structuring, research, benchmarking and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and quality. Effective communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage confidently with clients and internal stakeholders. Ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize effectively, and adapt to changing project requirements. Strong teamwork mindset, with the ability to work independently while seeking guidance when needed. Proficiency in both English and Arabic is required.

f243b1776f0e84f0.description: Eram Talent is actively recruiting for a Document Controller to support our operations in Saudi Arabia. The successful candidate will play a crucial role in the documentation management process, ensuring that all project's documents are systematically controlled and maintained to support project requirements effectively. This position is ideal for someone who possesses strong organizational skills and is adept at leveraging document control systems to facilitate efficient document processing and retrieval. As a Document Controller, you will manage the flow of documents, ensuring that they are received, tracked, and stored securely and accurately, thus allowing project teams to operate smoothly. Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (Business Administration, Engineering, etc.). Minimum of 3 years of experience in document control within the construction, contracting company or engineering industry. Relevant experience as a document controller for management preferably with Saudi Aramco or Saudi Aramco contracting company Familiarity with document management software, particularly Aconex or similar systems. Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel, Word, and PowerPoint. Strong understanding of document control processes and procedures. Excellent attention to detail and accuracy. Effective communication skills in both written and spoken English. Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and manage multiple priorities. Strong problem-solving abilities and critical thinking skills.

f235b8f36b9e255c.description: Eram Talent is seeking an analytical and detail-oriented Data Program Analyst to join our team in Saudi Arabia. In this role, you will be instrumental in managing and analyzing data programs to enhance operational efficiency and decision-making processes. As a Data Program Analyst, you will collaborate closely with various teams to translate raw data into meaningful insights, ultimately contributing to the success of our initiatives. Responsibilities Assist in the design, implementation, and management of data programs aimed at collecting and analyzing vital information. Collect and manage data from various sources, ensuring its accuracy and integrity. Develop and maintain dashboards and reports to monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and program outcomes. Analyze program data to identify trends, challenges, and opportunities for improvement. Support stakeholders by providing insights and recommendations based on data analysis. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure effective data sharing and communication. Prepare presentations and reports to convey complex data in a clear and actionable manner. Stay updated with industry trends and best practices in data analytics and program management. Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field. 3+ years of experience in data analysis or program management. Proficiency in SQL and experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI). Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret and present data effectively. Experience with programming languages such as Python or R is a plus. Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to handle multiple tasks. Strong communication skills, both verbal and written. Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment. Fluency in English; proficiency in Arabic is a plus.

f21acc458344f041.description: Müller's Solutions is seeking a talented Experience Designer with 5 to 10 years of experience and CCXP certification for a 6-month project aimed at enhancing our customer experience design capabilities. In this role, you will contribute to our mission of delivering exceptional experiences across our digital platforms while leveraging your expertise in customer experience principles. As an Experience Designer, you will work closely with cross-functional teams, including product management and development, to create user-centered solutions that address our clients' needs. Your responsibilities will include conducting in-depth user research, creating journey maps, developing wireframes and prototypes, and gathering user feedback to iteratively improve designs. This project presents a unique opportunity to impact our strategic initiatives and help shape our customer experience vision. Responsibilities: Lead and conduct user research to understand customer needs, pain points, and behaviors. Develop detailed customer journey maps and personas to guide design initiatives. Create wireframes, prototypes, and visual designs for web and mobile applications. Collaborate with product teams to define design specifications and ensure alignment with business objectives. Facilitate design reviews, user testing sessions, and focus groups to gather insights and feedback. Iterate on designs based on findings from user feedback and usability testing. Stay updated with industry trends and best practices in customer experience design. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field. 5 to 10 years of experience in experience design, UX/UI design, or related roles, with a robust portfolio showcasing your design processes and outcomes. CCXP certification is required. Proficiency in design tools such as Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch, or similar software. Strong understanding of user-centered design principles and methodologies. Experience in designing responsive applications for diverse platforms (web and mobile). Excellent communication and teamwork skills, capable of collaborating with diverse teams. Knowledge of front-end development technologies is an advantage. Preferred qualifications: Proven experience conducting user research and usability testing. Experience in creating customer journey maps and other experience design artifacts. Familiarity with accessibility standards and best practices in design. Innovative mindset with a strong focus on customer-centric solutions. 5+ years of experience in leading design engagements or projects is preferred. Soft Skills: Excellent visual design skills with the ability to create engaging user experiences. A collaborative spirit, with a passion for working in dynamic team environments. Strong attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality design outcomes.
